narration:0:1064006001:0.text: Although you all enjoy beautiful dreams, none of you remember anything from them, let alone gain any insights.
narration:0:1064006001:0.source_cn: 虽然你们做了美梦，但似乎都没有保留梦中的记忆，更别谈获...

narration:1:1064006002:0.text: Could this be yet another prank from Tasi? With that doubt in your mind, you set off for Cedartown.
narration:1:1064006002:0.source_cn: 该不会这也是塔西的恶作剧吧？你们抱着这样的猜测，去往了...

say:3:1064006003:1.text: The third ingredient is... a monster with psychic power? What's that?
say:3:1064006003:1.source_cn: 第三个食材——拥有精神属性的怪物……究竟是什么呢？

document:3:419:2.text:
<style="highlight">Ingredient 3: Psychic Monster Meat</style>
The psychic monster meat is both the trickiest yet the most essential ingredient, as these creatures can manipulate minds or create illusions.
It is recommended to wear a tinfoil hat during this step.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 4: Rich Element Essence</style>
Element essence serves as a medium to combine other ingredients. Any essence will do, as long as it is pure.
document:3:419:2.source_cn:
<style="highlight">【材料三·拥有精神属性的怪物肉】</style>
拥有精神属性的怪物肉最为危险，也最为关键。此类生物往往具有操控心智或制造幻象的能力。
处理肉块时需要格外小心精神污染。
 
<style="highlight">【材料四·浓郁的元素精华】</style>
浓郁的元素精华是联结其他材料的媒介，使用何种元素皆可，但必须为纯净元素。
